home.eyebrow: For guitar classes on Zalo and Facebook
home.subhead: One link for the group. Students send a take. howl0 lines it up with your score and tutorial so you can reply.
home.demoHint: Teachers run the class link. Students send a take.
home.studentEntry: Already have a class code from your teacher?
home.how1Body: Name the class, copy /c/…, invite students by link or email.
home.how2Body: Build your curriculum, then assign a piece or a whole part to the class.
home.how3Body: Takes land in a table. Open a row to watch, edit the draft, and send.

auth.title: Enter howl0
auth.body: Sign in to create a student upload link.
auth.pickBody: Teacher and student accounts start with different questions, so the first screen matches where you are.
auth.tutorBody: Make a class, assign pieces, reply from submissions.
auth.studentBody: Join with a class code, watch the tutorial, send your video.
auth.tutorFormBody: Use the email for your studio.
auth.studentFormBody: Use the email you want replies sent around.
auth.welcomeSub: Sign in to your practice room.
auth.forgotNeedEmail: Enter your email, then ask for the reset link.
auth.resetSent: Check your email for the reset link.
auth.createSub: Teachers and students start in different rooms.
auth.manifesto: Practice, record, and hear back from your teacher.
auth.providerFailed: That sign-in did not start. Turn the provider on in Supabase, then try again.
auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm the account if confirmation is on.
auth.wrongRoleTutor: This email is a teacher account. Sign in as a teacher.
auth.wrongRoleStudent: This email is a student account. Sign in as a student.

student.submitKicker: Record · upload · send to your teacher
student.dropHint: MP4 or MOV · up to 90 seconds
student.notePlaceholder: Where it got hard, or what you want heard.
student.noSentBefore: Nothing sent for this piece yet.
student.sent: Sent. Your teacher will reply soon.
student.name: Name
student.consent: This video is shared with this teacher and used to improve feedback. It can be deleted on request.
student.under18Line: I am over 18 or have a parent's consent.
student.publicOk: Allow this video in the group
student.publicForcedOff: Students under 18 never appear on the wall.
student.contactRequired: Enter a Zalo number or Messenger link.
student.joinHelp: Enter the class code your teacher sent.
student.otherClass: This account is already in another class.
student.stageExploring: You haven't joined a class yet.
student.stageExploringHelp: Ask your teacher for the /c/ class code, then join here.
student.stageInClassHelp: Open an assigned piece, watch the tutorial, send a take.
student.practiceTooShort: Practice at least 15 seconds, then stop.
student.practiceFailed: Could not save that practice session.
student.scheduleHelp: Your lessons with each teacher. Tap a block for details.
student.deleteTakeConfirm: Delete this take and its video? This cannot be undone.
student.videoPending: The video is not ready yet.
student.noTakes: You haven't sent a take yet.
student.noLessonYet: No lesson on the calendar yet.
student.takeHelp: Your teacher watches this and replies.
student.overdubHelp: Record over the teacher's clip. Your teacher replies.

onboarding.tutorBody: Three short questions so the first screen matches how you teach.
onboarding.studentTitle: Where are you in the song?
onboarding.studentBody: A few questions so we know if you are exploring or already in a class.
onboarding.name: Name
onboarding.tutorQ1: How do students send videos today?
onboarding.tutorQ3: What do you want to reply about first?
onboarding.studentQ1: Class code from your teacher (if you have one)
onboarding.studentQ2: How long have you been playing?
onboarding.badCode: That class code was not found.

teacher.dashHelp: Create a class, assign curriculum, review submissions.
teacher.stageStartingHelp: Make a piece link, post it in the group, wait for the first take.
teacher.stageCollectingHelp: Open the queue when a take lands. Edit the draft, then send.
teacher.stageRunningHelp: Work the queue, send replies, invite the next students.
teacher.linkHelp: Add a class, then share /c/… Students join the roster, then practice assigned pieces.
teacher.catalogHelp: Files are saved to catalog/song-1, then song-2, then song-3. A score or a tutorial is enough to train; both is better.
teacher.title: Piece title
teacher.sheetHint: Optional. PDF or image of the sheet music. Max 20 MB.
teacher.tutorialHint: Optional. Shown on the student link. Max 90 seconds or 60 MB.
teacher.replaceHint: Already saved. Choose a new file only if you want to replace it.
teacher.needFile: Choose a score or tutorial video.
teacher.staleReply: This take was already answered. Refresh the queue.
teacher.modelNeedAssets: Add a score or a tutorial to train
teacher.modelHelp: This is what train wrote from the score and/or tutorial. Compare checks a take against this list — not against another audio file.
teacher.modelNoChords: No chord list (tutorial-only, or empty extract).
teacher.compareNone: No compare facts on this take yet.
teacher.takeModelNone: No take extract yet. Keep the worker on and refresh.
teacher.modelDeskHelp: Left is the trained piece from the tutorial/score (already processed). Right is a chart of this take’s video. Notes under the take are Basic Pitch from the audio — that is the pitch source, not Gemini.
teacher.heardNotesNone: No Basic Pitch notes yet. Keep the worker on with BASIC_PITCH=1.
teacher.revertReplyConfirm: Take this reply back? The student will no longer see it, and you can send a new one.
teacher.badGrade: Choose a grade from A to F, or leave it empty.
teacher.factBarsHelp: Tap the time to hear it. Mark every bar true or false, then the letter is written from the true ones.
teacher.factDraftGate: Mark every bar true or false, then the letter is written.
teacher.factDraftWait: Writing the letter from the true bars…
teacher.factDraftTimeout: The letter is still coming. You can write it yourself.
teacher.voicesReadOnly: Voice samples are edited by founders in admin.
teacher.voicesHint: One sample per line. The newest {n} stay active.
teacher.postLine: Send your video through this link for feedback.
teacher.clipHint: Students record over this clip. Max 2 minutes or 40 MB.
teacher.aiDirectOn: AI-direct is on for this piece.
teacher.classesHelp: A class is people: roster, invite, schedule, attendance.
teacher.classesEmpty: No classes yet. Create one to invite students.
teacher.inviteEmailHelp: We create a pending seat. Copy the join link or open mailto — no mailer.
teacher.assignedEmpty: Nothing assigned yet. Drag a piece here from Curriculum.
teacher.curriculumHelp: These levels are yours. Rename one, put your songs on it, and assign a song when a student is ready.
teacher.assignTargetRequired: Pick a class or a student.
teacher.submissionsHelp: Takes sit in class folders, then by piece.
teacher.deleteTakeConfirm: Delete this take and its video? This cannot be undone.
teacher.scheduleHelp: Upcoming sessions per class. Open a session to mark attendance.
teacher.scheduleCalendarHelp: Click a time slot to add a lesson, or open a block to edit details and mark attendance.
teacher.meetingHint: Paste the Meet or Zoom link from your account. Each student gets a join button on this lesson.
teacher.meetingInvalid: Use an https link from meet.google.com or zoom.us.
teacher.paymentHint: Paste a link and it appears on the parent report. Leave it empty to hide the button.
teacher.dragHint: Drag a piece or a part onto a class
